Senior software engineer & solutions architect – data-centric platforms, API integrations, production delivery, applied generative AI workflows.

Senior software engineer and solutions architect with 25+ years of experience building and operating business-critical platforms (high-traffic web, integration services, data-centric systems). Strong background in backend engineering, API design, observability, incident-driven improvements, and structured data processing (XML/XSD, JSON/JSON Schema). Recent applied generative AI focus: integrating LLM APIs into multi-step workflows, constraining outputs with formal schemas, and implementing validation/error-handling patterns so AI features are reliable and maintainable in production. Comfortable in product-facing environments with ownership, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration; English working proficiency.

REST APIs & integration services: contract-first design (OpenAPI/Swagger), OAuth2, webhooks, multi-system workflows (CRM/ERP/partners).

Data stores: PostgreSQL, MySQL; XML databases (BaseX, eXist-db); data synchronization and ETL patterns.
Product-oriented delivery: backlog-driven iterations, scope negotiation with stakeholders, pragmatic quality improvements.
Mentoring and technical leadership: code reviews, guidance on architecture and quality practices, onboarding support.
English working proficiency; experience collaborating with distributed teams.
Observability: dashboards, KPIs, log analysis and incident troubleshooting (including Kibana-based monitoring depending on projects).
CI/CD & environments: GitHub/GitLab pipelines, Docker, Linux; multi-environment deployment workflows and reproducible dev/test setups.
Testing: integration and end-to-end scenario automation; refactoring guided by tests and debugger feedback loops.
TypeScript / modern web: strong proximity through Angular/TypeScript maintenance, WebSocket-based real-time features, and API contract work across front/back teams.
Python: practical experience via ERP/integration work (Odoo customizations) and data-centric workflows.
React: familiarity with component-based UI approaches and integration constraints; ready to ramp up quickly in a React monorepo environment.
